name: Vourukasha Oasis
description: Vourukasha Oasis is the birthplace and homeland of the Pari, who act as its guardians. It holds a "sea of pure dew" (Amrita) created from the remnants of the original Hydro Archon, Egeria. At the Oasis's center grows the Harvisptokhm, a giant tree that contains Egeria's remaining consciousness.
